entities.summary: Bobby Hart is an American professional football offensive tackle for the Los Angeles Chargers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida State Seminoles and was selected by the New York Giants in the seventh round of the 2015 NFL draft. Hart has also been a member of the several other NFL teams.
